snippet.title: Boing Fight – Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam – Physics Party Brawler for 1–4 Players
snippet.description:
Boing Fight is out now on Steam! 🎉 −40% for the first two weeks.
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363430/Boing_Fight/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=premiera

A bouncy physics party brawler for 1–4 players – on one couch or online, with bots for empty seats. 18 weapons, 30 kinds of traps, 150 arenas, 7 game modes and an arena editor with Steam Workshop, plus 14 art styles – from a 1930s cartoon to 8-bit and comic book.

All gameplay in this trailer was recorded in the game.

🇵🇱 Boing Fight już na Steamie! Sprężysta bijatyka z fizyką dla 1–4 graczy – na jednej kanapie albo online, a boty zajmą wolne miejsca. Na start −40% przez dwa tygodnie.

#BoingFight #indiegame #partygame #couchcoop #localmultiplayer
